column1: # COQ8A nucleotide-site and regulatory residues mapped across the UbiB/ABC1 family.
# Reference: PDB 5I35 chain A (human COQ8A R611K + AMP-PNP, 2.3 A). The 19 contact residues are
# all heavy atoms within 4.5 A of ligand ANP 700; K276, Q279 and E411 are added as diagnostics.
# Two independent mappings were computed and are both reported:
#   seq     = global Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap open -11 extend -1, COQ8A residues 251-647 vs full-length target.
#   struct  = sequence-independent structural alignment of the AlphaFold DB v6 model onto 5I35.
#             Seeded by gapless threading over all offsets, then 5-6 cycles of (Kabsch superposition with
#             outlier trimming) + (dynamic programming on the TM-score similarity matrix, gap -0.6).
#             No external alignment or superposition package was used.
# "AGREE" means the two independent methods returned the same target residue identity.
# ADCK2 required the full-length window (1-626); windows that truncated the N-terminal extension
# gave TM 0.21-0.63 and unreliable mappings, which is reported here as a method limitation.
